text:
**Flux Society Young Investigator Award winners who also served on a Flux Congress program committee**

| Year (Young Investigator Award) | Winner | Congress Year(s) served on Program Committee | Source |
|---|---|---|---|

|------|-------------------|--------------------|

| 2 | Flux 2020 Virtual Congress page – “Program Committee” section | Included Damien Fair and Dylan Gee |
| 3 | Flux 2021 Virtual Congress page – “Program Committee” section | Included Kate Mills |
| 4 | Flux 2022 Paris Congress page – “Scientific Program Committee” section | Included Kate Mills and Eva Telzer |
